maddeler.t: Borrowed from Medieval Greek κοντάκιον (kontákion), diminutive of Medieval Greek κόνταξ (kóntax, “pole”), diminutive of κοντός (kontós, “pole”).

Borrowed from Ottoman Turkish قونداق (kundak, “bundle, faggot; rifle butt”), from Medieval Greek κοντάκιον (kontákion), diminutive of Medieval Greek κόνταξ (kóntax, “pole”), diminutive of κοντός (kontós, “pole”).
s: Ottoman Turkish قونداق (kundak, “bundle, faggot; rifle butt”)
g: cloths wrapped around an infant, “baby roll”, swaddling-clothes
gun carriage, mount of a cannon
